annotation.title_clean: Giving Visibility to the Invisible: Measuring informality
annotation.title_en: Giving Visibility to the Invisible: Measuring informality
annotation.authors_or_issuer: International Labour Organization (ILO), Department of Statistics
annotation.summary_en: ILO Department of Statistics infographic on measuring the informal economy. It reports that over 60% of employed people (2 billion) are in informal employment, and it stresses the need for better statistics to support decent work policymaking. It has no AI or robotics content.
key_provisions_or_claims: More than 60% of employed persons (2 billion) are in informal employment
Informal enterprises produce up to 39% of GDP in low-income countries
Women in informal employment are 2.7 times more likely to work from home
Measuring informality is critical to understanding decent work deficits
ILO Department of Statistics offers tools and guidance on labour statistics standards
